therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Japanese patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Number of participants who experienced at least one adverse event (AE) up to 14 days after last dose

results.effect_size: 2 participants per dose group experienced at least one AE; 0 participants discontinued due to AE across all groups
results.target_engagement_evidence: Dose-proportional increases in AUC(0-24hr) and Cmax observed across 5–40 mg doses
biomarker_changes: AUC(0-24hr) Day 1: 754, 1900, 3230, 8700 nmol*hr/L for 5, 10, 20, 40 mg respectively
AUC(0-24hr) Day 5: 883, 2360, 3560, 9730 nmol*hr/L for 5, 10, 20, 40 mg respectively
Cmax Day 1: 105, 255, 487, 1340 nmol/L for 5, 10, 20, 40 mg respectively
Cmax Day 5: 128, 292, 509, 1240 nmol/L for 5, 10, 20, 40 mg respectively
t1/2 Day 5 ranged from 7.7 to 9.9 hr across doses
Accumulation ratios for AUC(0-24hr) ranged from 1.09 to 1.28 across doses
subgroup_findings: Day 5/Day 1 AUC accumulation ratio: 1.18 (5 mg), 1.28 (10 mg), 1.09 (20 mg), 1.10 (40 mg)
Day 5/Day 1 Cmax accumulation ratio: 1.21 (5 mg), 1.18 (10 mg), 1.02 (20 mg), 0.90 (40 mg)
Day 5/Day 1 C24hr accumulation ratio: 1.10 (5 mg), 1.77 (10 mg), 1.44 (20 mg), 1.65 (40 mg)
safety_signals: 2 participants per dose group (including placebo) experienced at least one AE
No participants discontinued study drug due to an AE in any group

dose_info.dose: 5 mg, 10 mg, 20 mg, or 40 mg tablets
dose_info.schedule: three times daily before every meal (q.a.c.) for 5 days

context.duration: 5 days treatment with up to 14 days follow-up after last dose
